why: Cloth physics settings for the gallery's Akane (cloth.js). stiff: per point down the chain, the share of the way back to the rigid pose each 1/60 s step; damp: velocity lost per step; gravity: 1 = real, measured against the bind pose; maxAngle: the furthest a bone may turn from its rigid direction; margin: added to the body capsules for this cloth; ringMax / ringMin: how far neighbouring skirt chains may drift apart / together (x their rest distance). legFollow: how much the skirt's target follows the thighs (each chain the thigh on its side, the centre chains both), so the knees stay covered; legSide sharpens which thigh a chain follows.
